title: Visa for Schengen trips
audiences: [ANY]

phrasings:
  - do I need a visa for Europe
  - schengen entry rules
  - entry requirements for France and Germany
---

Citizens of the US, Canada, the UK and Australia can enter the Schengen area without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180. Other nationalities need a Schengen visa from the embassy of the main destination. We send the checklist after booking.
